item.tib: tshe sgrab 'od dkar dpag med kyi bskang ba ye shes snyi ma
item.coloph: ces zab lam tshe ru sgrub pa'i skong ba ye shes snyi ma zhes bya ba 'di yang?'chi med gtsug phud kyang 'od dkar dpag med kyi skur bzhengs te/ tshe bdud nag po btul nas/ gshen gsang ba 'dus pa la bstan nas rim gyis brgyud nas/ bla chen dran pas rgyas 'bring bsdus pa mang du phyes te/ grol thob sems dpa' brgyad la gdams pas/ tshe yi rig 'dzin gyi skur brnyes nas/ stang chen gyis bon bstan dar nub dus su gter kha cha gnyis su sbas so/ phyis su dus la bab tshe gter kha cha gnyis dgongs pa chig dril du/ 7tshe dbang bla ma'i rjes 'breng tshe dbang bde chen snying po bdag la/ snying bu shes rab phun tshogs dang*/ bla chung tshul khrims bstan 'dzin sogs res 'gas bskur (bskul) ba la brten nas/ stang chen bla ma'i zhal lung bzhin du shar grol smin gling du dkar chag yi ger btab pa'o//
